finalText:
Done. Moved all 12 remaining call sites over to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, across the support, orders, catalog, billing, analytics, and accounts packages.

One file still uses the old form: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. It's a vendored copy, marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade." I left it alone rather than have your changes get silently wiped on the next upgrade.
